author: Tonko
highlights: Prohibits AI tracking of individual gambling habits
body: Federal standards prohibit sportsbooks from using individualized AI tracking to identify and exploit risky gambling habits. A national rule prevents companies from forum-shopping weaker state regimes and creates a clear enforcement hook before addictive behavior escalates.

tag: Unregulated markets cause operators to use AI for revenue
author: Pampus
highlights: Operators optimize timing and promotions around vulnerable users
body: Artificial intelligence can be used by online sports betting operators to grow revenue by targeting user behavior, personalizing promotions, and optimizing the timing of offers around risky gambling patterns. Regulation is key because the profit incentive points toward more intensive personalization.

tag: Uniform rules are stronger than state-by-state enforcement
author: Fisher
highlights: Prevention must happen before losses escalate
body: State treatment funding is necessary but insufficient because sportsbook systems can detect vulnerability and increase engagement before users ever reach treatment programs. Prevention depends on constraining personalization at the platform level.
